parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under an Examples/ directory — a canonical sample-app location. The canonical implementation already exists in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' (package: DebugPanel). The WallpaperSampleApp copy is almost certainly a self-contained demonstration that intentionally inlines the display-link setup rather than taking a dependency on the DebugPanel package, which is a common pattern for sample apps that must remain standalone. Consolidating it would couple the sample app to DebugPanel, defeating its purpose.
